description: R62 P1-02 / R63 P0-04: Signed migration manifest — trust anchor for migration integrity. The manifest binds release_commit, tree_sha, per-migration sha256, migration order, and tool version. CI signs the canonical manifest with cosign keyless (Sigstore) and verifies the certificate identity/issuer before any deployment or migration execution. The signature is a detached .sig file alongside the manifest; the manifest itself contains the expected verification policy (certificate_identity + certificate_oidc_issuer). A tampered disk file whose sha256 does not match the manifest blocks startup (fail-closed). R63 P0-04: release_commit/tree_sha regenerated from current HEAD; 004 migration enumerated; manifest must equal the on-disk migration set (no missing/extra entries).

verification.note: R62 P1-02: Detached signature generated by cosign sign-blob --keyless in CI sign-image job. Verification must pin certificate_identity to this repository's release-gates.yml workflow and certificate_oidc_issuer to GitHub Actions OIDC. Tag-based verification is prohibited; only digest/commit-bound verification is accepted.
